ruleDefinitions.name: User Added To Admin Group Via Sysadminctl
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to create and add an account to the admin group via "sysadminctl"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/sysadminctl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-addUser\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-admin\\ .*")))
